description.narrative: The aim of the partnership project is to continue the wonderful work initiated by FUN and TLF during the pilot project. The three main objectives of this partnership project are; i) Advocating against the discrimination and abuse of adolescent girls and young women ii) Strengthening leaders in organisational and advocacy skills, competency and values, and iii) equipping and empowering adolescent girls and young women with tools and resources necessary to achieve financial independence and sustainable self-development. Advocacy will be the pivotal focus of this project, and we will focus on issues such as gender based violence, sexual abuse, forced teenage marriages and teenage prostitution. The main activities will include several advocacy campaigns, workshops, seminars, youth camps, and vocational training programs, with the target group being adolescent girls and young women between 11 and 25 years old. The project will focus on low-income areas, in four constituencies in Zambia, namely; Kutuba, Chilanga, Chainama and Kuomboka.
